text_block_list.text:
The showdown against Special Week.
The day of the decisive battle, the Tenno Sho (Spring), had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—I'll do it. —I'll do it.
—I'll prove I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I pushed myself... right to the edge of the abyss.
With this level of preparation..."
( R O O O O A A R ! )

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"You're really fired up, Cafe-san!
But if you think you're gonna win, think again!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Carrots, sweet potatoes, raw whitebait! I ate
a whole bunch, so I went and ran it all off!

Manhattan Cafe and Special Week's
conversation is completely out of sync.
Setting that aside for now――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Good grief. The more the heart roars, the more the body screams in protest, huh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"How are they doing, your hooves and radius?
Your devoted care and my scientific therapy.
Working together in tandem is what brought us this far, after all."
choice_data_list: Think this race is going to be tough?
Think this race is going to be tough?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, today should be fine.
What comes next is uncharted territory, though. The real trouble is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "It's Cafe's motivation. The fact that her core issues are gone is turning into a new poison."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: "Plan B"... I suppose that might be straying a bit too far off the beaten path.
I gaze at Manhattan Cafe's terribly brooding face.

If I may be permitted... I want to say it.
—Do not pursue your "friend."

However, that is the one thing I cannot say.
Because it is the very first promise I made with Manhattan Cafe on the day we signed our contract.
For today—all I can do is pray for her safety.
